scope: Reference-only evidence for command-compiled ChemSmart design; no source is vendored, executed, or treated as proof of ChemSmart efficacy.

claims.locator: Design evidence and bounded inferences / NL2Bash
claims.bounded_inference: Treat natural-language command generation as semantic parsing, not as permission for model-authored shell.

claims.locator: Design evidence and bounded inferences / PICARD
claims.bounded_inference: Use typed IR and deterministic compiler checks when token-level constrained decoding is unavailable.

claims.locator: Design evidence and bounded inferences / Synthesize, Execute and Debug
claims.bounded_inference: Return structured counterexamples for bounded repair; do not permit free-form regeneration.

claims.locator: Design evidence and bounded inferences / QuickCheck and Hypothesis
claims.bounded_inference: Use property tests to strengthen implementation oracles, never as a chemical-validity oracle.

claims.locator: Design evidence and bounded inferences / Csmith
claims.bounded_inference: Treat independent implementation disagreement as a defect signal.

claims.locator: Design evidence and bounded inferences / ChemGraph
claims.bounded_inference: Limit decomposition to independently computable, deterministically joined chemistry nodes.
